chapter: Brawls, the Ink Spots and boyhood recollections
title: Nazarro's death with two sets of books
summary: Nazarro lay dead for three days before being found, and the government had found two sets of books.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: As much money as he has made off of Buck and Bubbles. If I was that man -- oh, he must be turning over, wherever he is. He gotta be turning over. He can't lay in one spot. Too hard. You know what I mean? But that's life for ya, and he died three days and nobody knew he was dead. He was dead for three days. Had to break into his apartment in order to find that he was in there.

Just died. All the breath went out of his body. (Chuckles) I don't know what kind of disease he had, he just din't breathe no more. I don't know whether that's a disease or not. Maybe it was the cheating of the government. They found two sets of books, you know. They broke him, because he paid the government. Whoever got the estate, I know they didn't got his money because he owed it to the government, must have. 'Cause you know when you go wrong with that, you go wrong. No catching
